articles.title: King Charles Reads Out Big Plans: Trains, Steel, and Digital IDs!
articles.summary: Imagine a super-fast train zipping between Liverpool and Manchester! That's one idea from the King's Speech. The government also wants to take over a steel company and create digital IDs. These plans could change how people travel and work.

articles.title: Trump Flies to China with Elon Musk and Other Big Bosses!
articles.summary: President Trump landed in China with a plane full of famous CEOs. Elon Musk, Apple's Tim Cook, and Nvidia's Jensen Huang are all there. They're talking about trade, AI, and maybe selling more stuff. It's a huge business trip!

articles.title: Nigel Farage in Trouble Over a Secret £5 Million Gift!
articles.summary: A politician named Nigel Farage got £5 million from a rich crypto investor. Now, a watchdog is checking if he broke the rules by not telling anyone. He says it was a personal gift for his safety, but others think it's fishy.
